_: tools/panel.py resolve(): which lemma a shared form key belongs to, where the rule cannot settle it. Value is the lemma's bare form, or bare|pos when two rows share the spelling. Read by the pool count (build_topics), the lookup index order and the example join (build_site), and the video index (build_transcripts).
_кружка: 2026-10-05: tableware teaches «кружка» (mug); its forms «кружка», «кружки», «кружку», «кружке» are also forms of «кружок» (circle, club), which took every sentence, so the mug was taught with none.
_голубой: 2026-10-01: the colour set teaches «голубой» the adjective; OpenRussian also lists a slang noun «голубой» with eight of its forms, and the noun took every sentence, so the colour was taught with none.
_p11.3: Measured over the shipped payload, 2026-09-10. gradeAlignment writes FSRS history through index[key][0], so a form credited to the wrong lemma schedules the wrong word. Counted by reading the English side of every corpus sentence containing the form.
_p11.5: Two rows where the closed-class reading is the word and the content row is a rarity or an inflection: «перед» the preposition against a paradigm-less noun glossed 'before', and «зовут» — a form of «звать» that others.csv carries as a headword of its own.
_taught_first: 2026-10-01: build_site now puts a taught candidate first in the lookup index when the rule's pick is not taught (семью opens семья, not 'seven times'). These keys keep the rule's pick against a taught rival, because in running speech the pick is the word: «бегу» is 'I run' far more than the dative of the taught noun «бег», «лечу» 'I fly' more than 'I treat', «давай» is 'let's' rather than an imperative of «давать», and «согласно» 'according to' rather than the short form of «согласный».
